args.assumptions: Required land = 30 MW x 2 ha/MW = 60 ha. Suitable cells: landcover cropland (1) or scrub (2); slope (Horn, degrees) <= 5 at cell centre; not inside or within 150 m (designation A) / 400 m (designation B) of protected areas, judged by cell centres on rasterised buffers; within 5 km of the HV line, judged by a 5 km buffer rasterised on cell centres. All layers share EPSG:32630 and the 25 m grid, so no reprojection was needed. The DEM contains no -9999 cells (set_nodata reported none), so no cells were lost to missing elevation and no slope nodata was produced. The 5 km line buffer covers the whole 3 km x 3 km grid, so the distance criterion is not binding. Largest 8-connected parcel is 58.31 ha (18 patches in total), which is below the 60 ha required, so the site is infeasible and yield is set to 0 per the brief. Clear-sky yield was not computed since it is defined as 0 when infeasible. Cell area 0.0625 ha; suitable area 3759 cells = 234.94 ha.

Required land = 30 MW x 1.6 ha/MW = 48 ha. Max line distance 5 km = 5000 m, judged by buffering the HV line by 5000 m and testing cell centres. Slope from DEM (Horn, degrees) with slope <= 7 accepted. DEM had no -9999 cells, so no no-data exclusion was needed. Protected areas reprojected from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:32630; designation A buffered 250 m, designation B buffered 600 m, zones judged at cell centres. Allowed land cover: cropland (1) and scrub (2). Parcels by 8-connectivity. Yield is the pvlib clear-sky upper bound (Ineichen), 30 MW, 30 deg fixed tilt, PR 0.80, not a bankable figure. Grid line of all 14400 cells lay within 5 km, so the distance criterion excluded nothing. Total suitable cells 5130 (320.625 ha) across 8 patches; largest patch 3171 cells (198.19 ha).

Required land = 2 ha/MW x 50 MW = 100 ha. Suitable cells: landcover cropland (1) or scrub (2); slope (Horn, degrees) <= 5 with DEM value -9999 declared as nodata; cells with nodata or touching a nodata cell (8-neighbour growth of 1 cell) excluded. All three protected-area polygons (PA-1 A, PA-2 B, PA-3 A) buffered 300 m (both designations same buffer), buffer zone judged at cell centres. Grid line buffered 8000 m and judged at cell centres; the buffer covers the whole 3 km x 3 km grid, so the distance limit excludes nothing. Parcels are 8-connected. Cell area 0.0625 ha (25 m cells). Clear-sky yield is 94.17 GWh/yr for 50 MW at 30 degree tilt, PR 0.80 (upper bound), but set to 0 because the largest parcel (57.94 ha) is below the 100 ha required, so the site is not feasible. No conflicts found in the documents; the readme gives no conflicting parameters.

Required land = 2 ha/MW x 30 MW = 60 ha (3744 cells... see mask). Grid is 25 m cells (0.0625 ha each). Slope limit 5 deg applied as slope <= 5 (Horn slope, degrees). Suitable land cover = cropland (1) and scrub (2). No DEM cells were no-data (no -9999 values present), so no nodata exclusion was needed. HV line distance is measured at cell centres; max cell-centre distance is 1828 m, so all cells satisfy the 8 km limit. protected_areas had one self-intersecting polygon (PA-2), repaired with fix_geometry before buffering. Both designations A and B use the same 300 m buffer, applied to all features; cells whose centre falls in a protected area or its buffer are excluded. Parcels are 8-connected. Clear-sky yield set to 0 because the largest parcel (57.94 ha) is below the 60 ha required, so the site is not feasible.

Required land: 50 MW x 4 acres/MW = 200 acres = 80.94 ha. Setbacks: 500 ft = 152.4 m (designation A), 1300 ft = 396.24 m (designation B), applied as buffers on the vectors, then rasterised with cell-centre rule (all_touched off). Line limit: 3 mi = 4828.03 m from grid_line, cell-centre rule; every grid cell lies within it, so it does not exclude anything. Slope computed in percent (Horn, GDAL/QGIS convention) and kept where <= 8%. Landcover classes 1 (cropland) and 2 (scrub) only. The DEM contains no -9999 cells (nodata count 0, min 511.7 m), so no further nodata exclusion was needed. Grid is 25 m cells (0.0625 ha each); parcels are 8-connected. Suitable mask = slope<=8% AND cropland/scrub AND outside A and B buffers AND within line distance: 3297 cells, 206.06 ha. Largest 8-connected parcel is 53.0 ha across 21 patches, below the 80.94 ha required, so the site is not feasible and clear-sky yield is reported as 0 per the brief (the 30-degree tilt, PR 0.80 yield was not computed for this reason).

Required land = 50 MW x 4 acres/MW = 200 acres = 80.94 ha. Setbacks: 650 ft = 198.12 m (A), 1650 ft = 502.92 m (B), applied as buffers on the reprojected (EPSG:32630) polygons; cell centres inside a buffer are excluded. Grid line: 5 mi = 8046.72 m buffer, cell-centre test; it covers the full 120x120 grid, so it does not constrain the site. Slope computed from the DEM (Horn, percent); 8% limit taken as slope <= 8 (no-data: none present, the DEM had 0 nodata cells, so no -9999 cells needed masking). Suitable land cover: cropland (1) and scrub (2). Protected areas (A and B) excluded with buffers. Parcels by 8-connectivity: 18 patches, largest 52.81 ha, which is below the 80.94 ha required, so the site is not feasible and yield is set to 0 per the brief. Clear-sky yield was not computed because the site is infeasible. Cell area 0.0625 ha (25 m cells). The readme document was consulted and contains no conflicting conventions.

Required land: 50 MW x 4 acres/MW = 200 acres = 80.94 ha. Buffers: 800 ft = 243.84 m (designation A), 2000 ft = 609.6 m (designation B), applied as Euclidean buffers and rasterized with cell-centre rule. Line limit: 5 mi = 8046.72 m; the maximum distance from any cell to the 132 kV line is about 1828 m, so this constraint excludes nothing. DEM sentinel -9999 declared nodata (808 cells); slope in percent (Horn); cells with no slope or touching a nodata cell (grown by 1 cell) are excluded. Slope <= 8% kept. Land cover: cropland (1) and scrub (2) only; forest, water and urban excluded. Protected areas: PA-1 and PA-3 are designation A, PA-2 is designation B. All layers already in EPSG:32630, so no reprojection was needed; no invalid geometries were found. Contiguity: 8-connected patches. Feasibility fails: largest parcel 52.5 ha is below the 80.94 ha required, so yield is set to 0 per the brief. The brief's 0-if-infeasible rule was applied; no clear-sky yield was computed for the 50 MW case. No conflicting documents were found (readme only).

Sources: readme.txt (only document; no conflicts). DEM 25 m grid, EPSG:32630; declared nodata -9999 but no such cells present, so no cells excluded for missing elevation. Slope in percent (Horn), slope <= 8.75% kept. Landcover 1 (cropland) and 2 (scrub) only. Protected areas: fixed invalid geometry (PA-2 self-intersection) with fix_geometry; buffered all features (A and B alike) by 984 ft = 299.92 m; a cell is excluded if its centre falls inside the buffer. Grid line: distance from cell centre to line <= 4.97 mi = 7998.44 m; all cells pass (max distance ~1828 m). Required land: 80 MW x 4.94 acre/MW = 395.2 acres = 159.93 ha. Parcels by 8-connectivity: 15 patches, largest 57.94 ha, which is below the 159.93 ha required, so the site is not feasible; yield set to 0 per the brief (clear-sky yield was not computed for the 80 MW case since it is infeasible). Mask suit_mask = slope ok AND (cropland or scrub) AND NOT in protected buffer AND within line distance; 3745 cells = 234.06 ha.

Used regulatory_note_current.txt (2026), which supersedes the 2019 note; the 2019 note was not used. Slope limit 8 percent (fixed tilt not permitted above it), computed from the DEM as percent slope (Horn). Buffers: designation A 500 ft = 152.4 m, designation B 2000 ft = 609.6 m, applied as polygon buffers and judged at cell centres; buffered zones include the protected polygons themselves. Connection: 3 miles = 4828.032 m from the 132 kV grid_line, judged at cell centres (distance_to_vector grid approximation). Land cover: cropland (1) and scrub (2) only. DEM has no -9999 cells (min 511.7 m), so no no-data masking was needed and no cells touched missing data. Required land = 2 ha/MW x 30 MW = 60 ha. Largest 8-connected parcel is 53.0 ha, below 60 ha, so the site is not feasible and clear-sky yield is reported as 0 per the brief. The clear-sky yield tool was not run for the infeasible case. Cell size 25 m (0.0625 ha per cell).

Required land = 80 MW x 1.6 ha/MW = 128 ha. 5 km = 5000 m; 200 m and 600 m buffers for designations A and B, applied to cell centres (rasterized without all_touched). Slope <= 7 degrees (Horn slope on the 25 m DEM, degrees) is suitable. Landcover classes 1 (cropland) and 2 (scrub) only. DEM has no nodata cells, so no nodata exclusion was needed. Line distance is cell-centre distance to the 132 kV grid line (max ~1.59 km, so all cells are within 5 km). Largest parcel uses 8-connectivity (4 patches). Required land = 50 MW x 2 ha/MW = 100 ha. Slope limit applied as slope <= 5 degrees (Horn slope, DEM in EPSG:32630, 25 m cells). DEM has no nodata cells, so no cells were excluded for missing elevation. Suitable land cover = cropland (1) and scrub (2). Protected areas (PA-1 A, PA-2 B, PA-3 A) all excluded with a 300 m buffer, applied to both designations, judged at cell centres (buffer polygon rasterised without all_touched). Vectors reprojected from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:32630 before buffering. The 8 km line-distance constraint, judged at cell centres, excludes no cells: the 132 kV line lies within the 3 km x 3 km grid so every cell is within 8 km. Parcels are 8-connected. Required land = 30 MW x 2 ha/MW = 60 ha. Slope suitable when slope <= 3 degrees (Horn slope on DEM with -9999 declared as nodata; cells touching nodata excluded via 1-cell grow). Landcover classes 1 (cropland) and 2 (scrub) only. Protected-area buffers: 250 m around designation A and 600 m around designation B, rasterised on cell centres (no overlap between zones). Line zone: 5 km buffer of the 132 kV grid_line, cell-centre rule; every grid cell lies within it, so the distance constraint does not bind. Parcels 8-connected (12 patches). All layers were already in EPSG:32630, so no reprojection was needed.

Required land = 80 MW x 2 ha/MW = 160 ha. Slope from the DEM (Horn, degrees), suitable if slope <= 3 degrees. DEM nodata is -9999 but the raster contains no such cells, so no cells were excluded for missing elevation or for touching it. Suitable land cover = cropland (1) and scrub (2). Protected areas: the invalid polygon (PA-2, self-intersection) was repaired before buffering. Buffers were 200 m for designation A (PA-1, PA-3) and 500 m for designation B (PA-2), rasterised on cell centres. The 10 km HV-line limit was applied as a 10 km buffer of grid_line, judged on cell centres; every cell lies within it. All layers share EPSG:32630 and 25 m cells, so no reprojection was needed. Parcels are 8-connected. Clear-sky yield is reported as 0 because the largest parcel (71.19 ha) is below the 160 ha required, so the site is not feasible. The fixed-tilt clear-sky yield was not computed.

Inputs: DEM and landcover are 25 m grids in EPSG:32630 (120x120); vectors already in that CRS, no invalid geometries. No DEM cells equal -9999 (no nodata cells), so no elevation gaps were removed. Slope computed in percent by raster_slope (Horn); slope <= 5% kept. Land cover kept: cropland (1) and scrub (2). Protected-area buffers: 650 ft = 198.12 m for designation A, 1300 ft = 396.24 m for designation B, applied to polygon edges and rasterised on cell centres (3 features: PA-1 A, PA-2 B, PA-3 A). Grid line: 6 mi = 9656.064 m, buffered and rasterised on cell centres; all 14,400 grid cells fall inside it, so the distance criterion does not exclude anything. Required land: 30 MW x 5 acres/MW = 150 acres = 60.70 ha. Largest parcel by 8-connected cells = 68.0 ha (15 patches), so feasible. Yield: pvlib clear-sky Ineichen, 30 MW, 30 deg fixed tilt, PR 0.80, 56.5 GWh/yr; this is an upper bound, not a bankable estimate. Cell area 0.0625 ha. The brief matched the protected-area and line rules as stated; no conflicts were found in the documents (readme only).

Units: 800 ft = 243.84 m (protected A buffer); 2000 ft = 609.6 m (B buffer); 6 mi = 9656.064 m (line distance); 4 acres/MW x 30 MW = 120 acres = 48.56 ha required land. Used the 2024-era readme only (no conflicting documents). Slope computed in percent from the DEM (Horn) and kept where <= 8%. DEM has no -9999 cells, so no cells were lost to nodata. Land cover allowed: 1 cropland and 2 scrub. Protected-area buffers were built as vector buffers in EPSG:32630 for designation A and B separately, then rasterised by cell centre. The HV line buffer (6 mi) covers the entire 120x120 grid, so the grid-distance criterion is non-binding. Final mask 'suitable' = slope<=8% AND cropland/scrub AND not in A or B buffer AND within 6 mi of line; overlap check with exclusion zones = 0 cells. Area = 4545 cells x 0.0625 ha. Largest 8-connected parcel 191.56 ha (13 patches) exceeds 48.56 ha required. Yield is the clear-sky pvlib upper bound (Ineichen), not a bankable estimate.

Required land = 50 MW x 5 acres/MW = 250 acres = 101.17 ha. Buffers: 500 ft = 152.4 m around designation A (PA-1, PA-3); 2000 ft = 609.6 m around designation B (PA-2); 3 mi = 4828.03 m from the 132 kV grid_line. Slope from DEM (Horn, percent) with -9999 declared nodata; slope <= 5% required. Cells with nodata and cells 8-adjacent to nodata excluded (grown nodata mask). Land cover classes 1 (cropland) and 2 (scrub) only. Zone and line tests judged at cell centres via centre-based rasterization of buffered polygons. All layers share EPSG:32630 so no reprojection was needed; protected-area geometries were valid. The line buffer covers the whole 3 km grid, so the line-distance criterion does not exclude any cell. Parcels are 8-connected. Clear-sky yield not reported because the site is not feasible (largest parcel 68 ha < 101.17 ha required), so 0 per the brief's convention.

Required land: 80 MW x 5 acres/MW = 400 acres = 161.87 ha. Buffers: 650 ft = 198.12 m (A), 1650 ft = 502.92 m (B); 3 mi = 4828.03 m. Slope computed in percent from the DEM (Horn); slope <= 5% kept. Only landcover classes 1 (cropland) and 2 (scrub) allowed. Zones rasterized on cell centres (all_touched off). protected_areas had one self-intersecting polygon (PA-2, designation B), repaired with fix_geometry before buffering. DEM has no nodata cells (-9999 not present), so no nodata exclusions were needed. All cells lie within 4828 m of the 132 kV line (max distance 1591 m), so the line criterion excludes nothing. Parcels use 8-connectivity; largest parcel is 68 ha across 14 patches, below the 161.87 ha required, so the site is infeasible and yield is reported as 0. Mask s2 = slope OK AND (cropland or scrub) AND NOT within A or B buffers. Area check: 2769 cells x 0.0625 ha = 173.06 ha.
